content.comment_body: Is anyone using an IoT development framework besides AWS for [product_name]? If so, could you share which ones? Thanks.

Hi, currently AWS is the only framework directly supported by [product_name]. To use [product_name] with other systems, you need a gateway—often a Raspberry Pi running Node-RED, using either S7 communication or Modbus TCP to connect with [product_name]. Other devices like Arduino can serve this purpose as well. For professional solutions from [company_name], check options like cloud connect or IoT xy. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked about alternatives to AWS for IoT development with [product_name], hoping to find other supported options. The responses clarified that AWS is the only natively supported framework for [product_name], and working with other IoT platforms typically requires intermediary hardware (such as Raspberry Pi or Arduino) to facilitate communication. The conversation highlighted the current dependency on gateways for integration with non-AWS IoT solutions.
analysis.user_expectations: User wishes for native support of multiple IoT development frameworks for [product_name], rather than exclusive compatibility with AWS.
